currentManifest.title: 6万分の1 ～ONE IN 60,000～
currentManifest.tagline: 世界に約6万人いるVTuberの、ひとりになる。
currentManifest.genre: VTuber career life simulation (auto-advancing months with decisions)
currentManifest.inspiration: Follows the basic structure of the browser life simulation 『80億分の1』 (random birth, auto-advancing time with speed control, four status values, focus, decisions, milestone questions, auto mode, final record card, people born at the same time, one-cell-per-period map). Independent fan-made adaptation; no code, text or assets from the original are used.
currentManifest.coreMechanic: Free-typed VTuber name + chosen aim genre; agency/job/language region/budget/streaming experience/three debut peers are random; one month per tick up to 144 months; hidden per-genre aptitude and audience reception move the visible direction away from the aim in roughly a quarter of auto-played careers; decisions, milestone one-line questions, retirement prompts and life-change/health/contract endings
skillAxes: following or resisting the audience's direction

inputs.setup: text input (16 chars, control/angle brackets stripped) and radio genre cards; Enter debuts
inputs.play: speed buttons pause/1x/2x/4x/next decision (1400/700/350/70 ms per month); おまかせ checkbox; six focus buttons; Space toggles pause, Escape opens the pause dialog
inputs.decisions: dialog buttons; question/farewell text inputs (60 chars, may be empty, Enter submits)

currentManifest.practice: Fixed seed, indie student 練習さん aiming 雑談; six months with normal events and decisions; no questions, no hazard endings, no save/history/run events
currentManifest.model: Monthly growth = (subs+20)*rate*luck + agency inflow*luck - subs*2.6% churn, rate from skill/bond/focus/genre fit/job/joy with log saturation; viral spikes; monetization at 1,000 subscribers; ranking among 60,000 from an assumed share curve (≥100: 58%, ≥1,000: 24%, ≥10,000: 6.5%, ≥100,000: 1.2%, ≥1,000,000: 0.09%) that is a game premise, not measured data
currentManifest.save: web-mini-arcade:v1:game038:state; in-progress career (including pending decision), last 10 record summaries, best rank, runs, last name/aim; practice never saved; denied writes stay memory-only
currentManifest.telemetry: game_open/run_start/run_end/retry-less restart via setup/pause/resume/quit/score/best_update(rank)/return_to_portal; run_end carries aim, direction, drifted, months, peak_subs, rank, outcome; remote disabled pending root registration; training excluded
currentManifest.art: DOM/CSS only: gradient avatar coloured from the name hash with the first character, emoji genre markers; no generated or external images; no real VTuber, agency or platform names
